invariants: On filtered or incomplete responses, never expose a partial function call to downstream execution
A content-filter block must remain visible as both stop reason and explainable stop details, including when function calls exist
Normal complete tool calls must remain executable
Refusal text must remain visible if present
Avoid changing shared stop-details collector behavior unrelated to this provider
Code patch must not alter the upstream fixture inputs or evaluation tests
not_claimed: Tool abuse in a deployed product
rubric.scoring: Each case is an independent executable check; failure of filtered-tool dispatch blocks acceptance regardless of mean score.

billing_requirement: Owner request-bound risk authorization (spec amendment 2026-11-03); provider offers no enforceable cap.
billing_verifier_status: billing_authorization.json with matching request_sha256 required; alerts-only provider limit documented
no_resend: Any send claim, failure, interruption or uncertain outcome consumes this reservation.

constraints: Edit only the bodies of the three supplied function excerpts.
Preserve function names, signatures, interfaces and unrelated behavior.
Preserve shared collect_stop_details behavior for all providers.
No extra files, imports, top-level execution, evaluator access, or fixture edits.
No reference, control or preexisting candidate is part of this request.

problem: A response interrupted by content filtering after beginning a tool call is converted to stop_reason="tool_calls" with no visible stop_details; a downstream agent could execute the partial call. Ordinary completed tool-call responses must continue to work. Stop reason, stop details and tool-call forwarding are separate control paths.
